name: Yomoyama Shouko
source:
The eldest daughter of an upper-middle class family. She has a serious older brother who is 3 years older and a crybaby younger brother who is 5 years younger. She hates her father and brother because they are picky, and cares about her mother and younger brother because they are shy.

Although she tends to seem intimidating due to her tone, demeanor, and bad eyes, she is friendly and caring. She gets lonely easily. She likes to talk, but she doesn't have much vocabulary, and her rapid-fire talking is exhausting to listen to. Contrary to her appearance and behavior, she can study and do housework. She has the ability to take action adn is not afraid of anyone, so she has great leadership skills. Her biggest flaw is that she's too reckless. She is in a rebellious period and loves to go out.

[Translated from [url=https://saya-sp.com/hanasaya_gp_op/layer_if/layer_ifb_character/]official website[/url]]
